entries.normative_statement: AsmWeb — Architecture & Engineering Specification v0.4 SHALL remain the governing architecture baseline.
This specification SHALL derive from and remain compatible with that architecture.
This specification SHALL NOT introduce a major capability outside the frozen architecture without an approved architecture decision.
An ACCEPTED ADR SHALL NOT be silently overridden by a requirement.
Applicable normative protocol standards SHALL take precedence over behaviour observed in another implementation.
A conflict between architecture, requirement, implementation or qualification evidence SHALL be explicitly resolved.
A deliberately deferred architectural decision SHALL remain deferred until its required evidence exists.
A normative requirement SHOULD express one independently verifiable proposition.
Compound requirements SHALL be decomposed where constituent propositions can independently pass or fail.
A requirement SHALL NOT use vague terms such as “fast”, “secure”, “efficient”, “robust” or “scalable” as its sole acceptance condition.
Every mandatory requirement SHALL be testable, inspectable, analytically demonstrable or explicitly classified as a design constraint.
A mandatory requirement for which no credible verification method exists SHALL be revised before requirements freeze.
Every normative requirement SHALL have a stable identifier.
A retired requirement identifier SHALL NOT later be reused for a different semantic requirement.
The human-readable specification and machine-readable requirement metadata SHALL remain semantically consistent.
AsmWeb SHALL be an experimental, security-conscious, high-performance web server for Linux x86-64.
AsmWeb SHALL be implemented primarily in x86-64 assembly.
AsmWeb SHALL expose computational machinery sufficiently explicitly to support meaningful measurement.
Correctness SHALL take precedence over performance.
Memory boundedness SHALL take precedence over performance.
Computational boundedness SHALL take precedence over performance.
Required interoperability SHALL take precedence over incompatible optimisation.
Measured evidence SHALL take precedence over performance folklore.
AsmWeb SHALL NOT require performance superiority over another web server to satisfy its v1 purpose.
AsmWeb SHALL permit investigation of the minimum software, memory and computational machinery required to transform HTTP requests into responses correctly and defensively.
AsmWeb SHALL permit comparative measurement of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 implementation cost.
AsmWeb SHALL permit measurement of externally induced computational work.
AsmWeb SHALL permit measurement of externally induced retained memory or state.
AsmWeb SHALL permit measurement of externally induced network output.
AsmWeb SHOULD permit decomposition of costs attributable to protocol processing, cryptography, kernel interaction, copying and memory movement where practical.
Negative experimental results SHALL remain valid project results.
Failed hypotheses SHALL remain historically visible.
HTTP/1.1 SHALL be REQUIRED.
HTTP/2 over TLS SHALL be REQUIRED.
HTTP/3 over QUIC SHALL be REQUIRED.
HPACK functionality necessary for qualified HTTP/2 SHALL be REQUIRED.
QPACK functionality necessary for qualified HTTP/3 SHALL be REQUIRED.
QUIC v1 functionality necessary for qualified HTTP/3 SHALL be REQUIRED.
